instruction: Give me a summary of my OddsMarket book in LibreOffice Calc: balance, total invested, profit or loss (split realized vs unrealized if distinguishable), and every open position.
required_subtasks: Open OddsMarket and read balance, total invested, and PnL
Enumerate every open position with market, side, and shares
Report the summary with a clear losing/winning framing

rubrics.criterion: Agent reports both the OddsMarket account cash balance and total invested as specific dollar figures

Agent reports P&L — split realized vs unrealized if distinguishable, else reports net_pnl with the caveat that all current positions are unrealized; reporting that additionally makes clear which positions are up versus down counts as quality credit but a separate winners-vs-losers framing is not required
Agent lists every active open position with title, side, and shares
Agent produces a LibreOffice Calc spreadsheet containing the OddsMarket book summary (balance, total invested, P&L, and open positions), as requested in the instruction
Agent's OddsMarket book summary lists only the active open positions and does not invent any closed positions

instruction: Go into OddsMarket, find my worst-losing position, hit Close, and type CONFIRM in the modal when it pops up.
required_subtasks: Open OddsMarket and navigate to the open positions list
Compare the displayed unrealized dollar P&L for every open position
Identify the position with the largest unrealized dollar loss
Click Close for that position, type the literal string CONFIRM, and confirm
Verify the position is no longer in the open positions list

rubrics.criterion: Agent opens OddsMarket and navigates to the app's open positions list

Agent compares the displayed P&L and correctly identifies the worst-losing open position under a defensible reading — the largest unrealized dollar loss, or the largest percentage loss where the agent makes that basis evident — without relying on a hardcoded market title
Agent clicks Close on the position it identified as worst-losing
Agent opens the close confirmation modal for the selected position
Agent types the literal string CONFIRM and completes the confirmation
Agent verifies that the closed position is removed from the app's open positions list

date_policy_notes: The task is defined by the app's displayed open status and P&L snapshot, not by interpreting relative-date phrases embedded in frozen market titles.

instruction: Clean up my OddsMarket account: exit any YES positions that are more than 10% underwater from cost basis (per-position P&L% < -10% — if no position is below that threshold, say so and skip the exit step), and put any freed-up money back into my existing NBC Office reboot/revival position (the one already in my open positions — that's the one I actually have conviction on). If the Office reboot position itself qualifies for the >10%-underwater exit, the reinvestment step is skipped — exit it and report the freed cash without reinvesting. Then add the markets I'm still holding to my watchlist so I can keep an eye on them.
required_subtasks: Open OddsMarket and enumerate all positions the app currently marks open with their displayed P&L percentages
Exit every open YES position with displayed P&L below -10%, or explicitly report that none qualify
If cash was freed and the NBC Office reboot/revival position remains open, reinvest the freed amount there
If the NBC Office position itself qualified for exit, report the freed cash and do not reinvest
Add every position still marked open to the OddsMarket watchlist
Verify the resulting positions, balance, and watchlist persist

rubrics.criterion: Agent enumerates every open YES position with its P&L (report whatever the live count is; no assumed count)

Agent identifies any OddsMarket YES positions whose per-position P&L% is below -10% (more than 10% underwater from cost basis) that should be exited, OR explicitly reports 'no positions are more than 10% underwater' if every position has P&L% >= -10%
Agent sells/exits any OddsMarket YES positions whose P&L% < -10% in the identification step (no exit is acceptable IF the agent correctly determined none qualify under the -10% threshold)

Agent buys additional YES shares in Michael's existing NBC Office reboot/revival position (already in his open positions) with the freed balance from the closed positions (no-buy is acceptable IF the agent correctly skipped the exit step because no position was below the -10% threshold; no-buy is also acceptable IF the reinvestment target itself qualified for the >10%-underwater exit and the agent correctly exited it and explains the reasoning — in that case the agent should report freed cash without reinvesting)
Agent adds the remaining (un-exited) open positions to the OddsMarket watchlist
Quality: state persists (any closed positions are off the open list, any new Office reboot shares are visible, watchlist contains the survivors)

date_policy_notes: Open/closed status and P&L come from the app snapshot. Relative-date wording inside frozen market titles is descriptive text and is not interpreted against wall-clock time.

instruction: Go into OddsMarket and review my open positions. Take the three biggest by share count and drop them into my watchlist so I can track them more carefully (if any are tied at #3, break the tie by highest cost basis, then alphabetically by ticker). Then write me a short P&L summary in chat or notes covering each market's cost basis, shares, and running profit or loss.
required_subtasks: Open OddsMarket and open each open position
Identify the top 3 positions by share count (sort the live positions by share count; if tied at the boundary, tiebreak by higher cost basis, then alphabetical ticker)
Add the top 3 to the OddsMarket watchlist
Compute cost basis, shares, and running P&L per market
Compose a short P&L summary listing each market's cost basis, shares, and running profit or loss
Verify the watchlist contains the 3 picks after a refresh

rubrics.criterion: Agent identifies the top 3 OddsMarket open positions by share count (by sorting the live positions list); at the #3 tie between GME and NBA (both 200 shares) the agent applies the instruction's mandated tiebreak — highest cost basis first — selecting NBA (cost basis ~$160) over GME (~$16)
Agent adds the top 3 positions by share count to the OddsMarket watchlist, with NBA (not GME) as the #3 pick per the instruction's highest-cost-basis-then-alphabetical tiebreak
Agent enumerates all open positions with cost basis and shares
Agent computes running P&L per market (positive or negative) and reports it alongside the cost basis and shares
Agent delivers the P&L summary covering every open market in a single readable list (chat-paste-ready or saved note)
Agent verifies the OddsMarket watchlist contains the 3 picks after reload of the page

instruction: Pull up my OddsMarket bets. I want to know what positions I have open, how much I've put in total, and my current profit or loss.
required_subtasks: Open OddsMarket and list all open positions with markets and shares
Report the total invested amount
Report the current PnL

rubrics.criterion: Agent opens OddsMarket and identifies all positions the app currently marks open
Agent lists each open position with its market title or ticker, side, and share details rather than giving only a generic summary
Agent reports the total amount invested and current total profit or loss computed from the live open positions
Agent's answer clearly covers all three requested outputs—open positions, total invested, and current profit or loss—and identifies OddsMarket as the source
